description: Per-repo Renovate config, processed by a self-hosted Renovate runner.

docker-compose managerFilePatterns lists both patterns explicitly: the standard compose pattern (covers tests/system/docker-compose.yml) and ha-demo.yml (covers scripts/docker/ha-demo.yml, which is not named compose* and would otherwise be missed).
ignorePaths replaces config:recommended's defaults so tests/ is NOT ignored (the CI compose file lives under tests/), while the docs snippet compose files are excluded.
chore(deps) commits keep dependency bumps out of the release-please changelog.
customManagers tracks HASS_HASSETTE_VERSION in scripts/docker/.env (the hass-hassette release the system-test and demo HA containers install) against NodeJSmith/hass-hassette's GitHub releases.

customManagers also tracks each GitHub-hosted hook repo's rev in prek.toml against its tags: Renovate's built-in pre-commit manager only reads .pre-commit-config.yaml, so prek.toml pins would otherwise go stale silently.

homeassistant/home-assistant is explicitly disabled (see packageRules) -- the .claude/skills/ha-version-bump skill owns bumping the compose-file HA image tags in lockstep with the codegen pin, monthly. Weekly Renovate PRs for this one package went unreviewed in practice.

Renovate runs daily and may open PRs on any run. prHourlyLimit is 0 because a run lasts minutes: the preset's 2/hour cap meant about 2 new PRs per run and a months-long queue. prConcurrentLimit still bounds how many are open at once.

Non-major updates automerge through GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass (tests-complete, e2e-complete, lint-complete, readthedocs), after minimumReleaseAge holds each release for 3 days. Docker images outside Docker Hub (e.g. ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv) skip that hold: the docker datasource only reports release timestamps for Docker Hub, and an update with no timestamp would wait forever. Major updates and language runtimes (python, java) never automerge. A non-major PR that fails CI or conflicts is picked up by the hassette-review-autofixes reviewer (Dotfiles packages/hassette-pipeline, reviewer_renovate.py).

Groups keep related bumps in one PR: prek, prek-action and every prek.toml hook rev move together; ruff's pre-commit hook moves with the ruff dev dependency so the two can't drift; npm and GitHub Actions non-major updates are batched.

customManagers.description: HASS_HASSETTE_VERSION in scripts/docker/.env pins the hass-hassette release that the system-test and demo HA containers install; tests/system/test_hass_hassette.py checks each bump
prek.toml hook repo revs (each `repo = "https://github.com/..."` line followed directly by its `rev = ...` line)

packageRules.description: homeassistant/home-assistant is bumped monthly by the ha-version-bump skill in lockstep with the codegen pin, not by Renovate
hassette-wire and hassette-client are workspace members pinned exactly to this repo's own version; release-please rewrites those pins, so Renovate must not open bump PRs against PyPI
Docker images outside Docker Hub have no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge would hold them forever; registry-prefixed names (a dot in the first path segment) skip the hold
Automerge non-major updates once the required checks pass

Language runtimes are upgraded deliberately and never automerged: a python 3.x minor is a language upgrade. matchDepNames, not matchPackageNames: the package names are python/cpython, actions/python-versions, java-jdk
prek tooling: every hook rev in prek.toml moves together
prek tooling: the prek CLI (mise.toml) and its GitHub Action join the hook revs
ruff's pre-commit hook rev moves with the ruff dev dependency. Listed after prek tooling so it wins for the hook
Batch frontend non-major npm updates into one PR
Batch GitHub Actions non-major and digest updates into one PR (prek-action stays in prek tooling; the python-version runtime pin is excluded)
